scheme.name: AP-8, AP-1 and AP-636, Basque Country (Interbiak, Bidegi)

dataset.method: Bidegi's tariff sheet in force from 1 January 2026 (Interbiak's and Bidegi's AP-8 and AP-1, Pesados 1 and 2, VAT included; Pesados 2 from Bilbao's western access to Zarautz's main plaza towards Donostia EUR 30.38): by entry and exit, either way, excluding 21% VAT. Stations: each carriageway's stretch between two consecutive entries/exits, placed at the OpenStreetMap junctions whose exits are signposted to them, Bilbao's western access and Etxabarri-Ibiña at the motorways' ends, Zarautz's main plaza and Donostia's eastern plaza at the toll booths on the carriageway; not placed (a trip from or to one priced from the next station): Luko, Oñaurre. AP-636: each section's price (either way) at the first Bidegi gantry on it going from Beasain (OpenStreetMap's gantries named Beasain, Ezkio, Deskarga); the sheet's Legazpi/Urretxu – Antzuola price by tag isn't modelled (a trip from Legazpi to Antzuola is charged Legazpi – Bergara, one from Antzuola to Bergara nothing). Not built: the sheet's prices from Zarautz E and Orio to Donostia's exits.

sources.title: Bidegi: AP-8, AP-1 and AP-636 tariffs 2026
